ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 30% high-intensity (white/tan) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous regions located at the distal tips of both lobes. Large tan-white mottled patches situated in the upper-inner quadrants. High-frequency distribution of small white speckles across the central low-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal angle of 95 degrees and significant depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire boundary; distinct peaks visible on the outer margins of both lobes, particularly the upper-right edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge trajectory with a slight tapering toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white clusters (scars) distributed across the dark central and lower-mid sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, high-contrast linear white disruptions (rake marks); three prominent diagonal lines on the left lobe and several horizontal marks near the fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks/scars crossing the ventral surface of the left lobe and the central region near the notch.
